    <section class="section" id="research" aria-labelledby="h-research">
      <h2 class="section__label" id="h-research">Research</h2>
      <div class="section__body section__body--wide">
        <div class="rq-grid">
          <article class="rq">
            <h3>What do students feel in physical education, and why?</h3>
            <p>I study achievement emotions such as enjoyment, pride, boredom and anxiety in PE lessons. Using control-value theory, I ask how students’ sense of control and the value they see in PE relate to these emotions.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="rq">
            <h3>How does variety in PE lessons relate to motivation and participation?</h3>
            <p>I study variety support: teachers varying activities, equipment, groupings and tasks. I also ask whether variety works as a fourth basic psychological need, alongside autonomy, competence and relatedness.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="rq">
            <h3>How can we measure students’ emotions in PE well?</h3>
            <p>I adapt and validate questionnaires and observation tools for physical education, including a brief questionnaire for elementary school students.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
